uncertain_points.claim: When EnableRacl is 0, RaclErrorRsp defaults to 0, which masks RACL error responses and effectively disables RACL enforcement.
uncertain_points.risk: RACL violations may go undetected, allowing unauthorized debug accesses to protected memory regions.

security_implications: This chunk defines the top-level interface of the debug module. Lifecycle signals (lc_hw_debug_en_i, lc_dft_en_i, etc.) control debug enablement; if they are subverted debug could be activated in unauthorized lifecycle states. RACL parameters (EnableRacl, RaclErrorRsp) govern access control for debug transactions; disabling RACL may bypass memory protection. The OTP signal otp_dis_rv_dm_late_debug_i can disable late debug, providing anti‑tamper capability. Alerts monitor integrity violations. Parameter SecVolatileRawUnlockEn may influence secure volatile unlock behavior. Together these signals cross multiple security boundaries and must be correctly configured and verified.
